en.title: Beneath the Calm, the Weight of Lies
en.premise: Minato is a young man born with a 'curse' that makes it impossible for him to lie. Fearing that his absolute honesty will only hurt those around him, he lives a quiet, secluded life in a seaside town. His world changes when he meets Shiori, a girl searching for traces of her late mother within an ancient underwater ruin. As the memories sleeping in the depths intersect with their raw, unfiltered words, the two begin to face an inevitable loss.

zh.title: 凪之底，谎言之重
zh.premise: 青年湊天生背负着“无法撒谎之诅咒”。因为担心真相会伤害周围的人，他在海边小镇过着静谧的生活。直到有一天，他在海中发现的古代海底遗迹中，遇见了追寻亡母身影的少女——栞。当遗迹中沉睡的记忆与赤裸的言语交织之时，两人开始面对那无法逃避的丧失。

prediction_results.question: 遺跡の中で見つけたものは？
